http_transport_policy.browser_auth_boundary: viewer browser routes use only the accepted cookie session; staff/admin remain Bearer until a separate browser shell slice

carrying a computed result to the caller through a mutated input
model_immutability_policy.replacement_shape: construct a new instance when a changed value must be carried

account.rationale: no earlier administrator exists to authorize, verify or reinstate this account, and authenticate_staff admits only an active account

atomicity.commit: once, and only after both inserts succeed

audit.entity_id_source: the created staff_id, serialized as = rules.audit_entity_id_policy requires

command_outcomes.stability: these codes are an external contract and are not renumbered by a regeneration

catching only Exception instead of BaseException

transaction_guard_policy.write_path: commit once on success and set the local flag to closed
